debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-e-r-g-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n-t-o one f-a-l-s-e b-a-t-c-h i-n-d-e-x and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-m-p-e-d c-o-p-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-w-r-o-t-e the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n t-a-g-s on the c-a-r-t-o-n boxes and l-e-f-t a p-r-i-n-t-o-u-t l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k-s-u-m
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n l-o-g-s to h-i-d-e the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e f-a-i-l-u-r-e and l-e-f-t a c-o-m-p-r-e-s-s-e-d c-o-p-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p r-e-v-i-e-w
4) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-a-l-e-d the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t-s in the e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-o-l-d-e-r and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-t-u-s n-o-t-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e and l-e-f-t a d-e-b-r-i-e-f s-t-a-m-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t
